title: The inhabitants of the forest village have never been without their traditional treat. But this time, on the eve of the holiday, all the cakes mysteriously disappear. Will the disappearance spoil the holiday for all the villagers and the New Year will not come? Or will there be a hero who will bring back something more important than just a holiday?

title: The best children's play I've taken my children and grandchildren to in years. Bright, colourful, fun, musical. The sets are beautiful and the changing of them is a beautiful part of the play. The animals are so funny - the bullfinch, tit, squirrels and others. The mother bunny is the obvious head of the family. A bear cub, running tirelessly along the stage in a thick fur coat. And uninterrupted jokes that do not leave even adults indifferent. Thanks to the whole team!
